title: What do we think it means?
content: First of all I can't believe I found a sub full of people having the same dream as me. Reddit is beautiful sometimes. I have a mall (and a whole town around it) that I've been dreaming about for as long as I can remember. I brought it up to someone who said maybe the mall is YOU and the stores are parts of you or your personality and your subconscious wants you to address something. There are some stores in my mall that are very specific to me, so maybe there's truth to it but I don't know how to make sense of like what my subconscious is trying to say with it. (Why is this one always dark and empty but it's unlocked? Why is this one only accessible from outside? I alwasend up fighting with someone if I bring them to this store. Etc) What does everyone think about why we dream of the same spot like this?
